codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: All 5 points adopted. Scope tightened from 9 fixes to 4 deterministic + 1 AC-only + 3 investigation + 1 deferred. AC-1 explicitly demands intrinsic-width derivation (not naive max-width removal). AC-17 uses shared helper covering both mcp__* and functions.read_mcp_resource. AC-16 made conditional on Phase 1 live-probe finding a Skill tool surface; if no surface found, AC closes by documenting absence (avoid dead code). #6/#14/#18 reclassified as investigation-only with concrete evidence-file ACs. #3 deferred to product cycle with explicit /close escalation.
